info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Magnetism API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: total_magnetization_max
params.description: Maximum value for the total magnetization.

params.name: total_magnetization_min
params.description: Minimum value for the total magnetization.

params.name: total_magnetization_normalized_vol_max
params.description: Maximum value for the total magnetization normalized with volume.

params.name: total_magnetization_normalized_vol_min
params.description: Minimum value for the total magnetization normalized with volume.

params.name: total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units_max
params.description: Maximum value for the total magnetization normalized with formula units.

params.name: total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units_min
params.description: Minimum value for the total magnetization normalized with formula units.

params.name: num_magnetic_sites_max
params.description: Maximum value for the total number of magnetic sites.

params.name: num_magnetic_sites_min
params.description: Minimum value for the total number of magnetic sites.

params.name: num_unique_magnetic_sites_max
params.description: Maximum value for the total number of unique magnetic sites.

params.name: num_unique_magnetic_sites_min
params.description: Minimum value for the total number of unique magnetic sites.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from MagnetismDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `material_id` `deprecated` `deprecation_reasons` `last_updated` `origins` `warnings` `structure` `property_name` `ordering` `is_magnetic` `exchange_symmetry` `num_magnetic_sites` `num_unique_magnetic_sites` `types_of_magnetic_species` `magmoms` `total_magnetization` `total_magnetization_normalized_vol` `total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units`
